hub_identity.reservation_rule: Reserve the ticket (atomic O_EXCL create) before writing runners, artifacts, data, or logs. Existing IDs are rejected across registry, JSONL, tickets, logs, artifacts, data, and runners.

hypothesis: candidate_pool: raw SEC Companyfacts annual R&D intensity acceleration (R&D/revenue rising year over year, with R&D spend growing faster than revenue) paired with liquid SPY-relative leadership may identify innovation-investment winners whose underappreciated reinvestment shows 10-day continuation beyond price-only and static profitability sources.
acceptance_rule: Gate 1-4 per docs/backtesting.md; positive replay remains lead only unless promoted through shared-paper-first parity.

prediction.confidence_reason: Raw SEC R&D expense is genuinely new versus the selected Companyfacts sidecar used in recent quality/profitability trials. The economic edge is plausible when rising innovation intensity is already confirmed by relative strength, but the Companyfacts family is saturated and R&D can select expensive long-duration names, so success odds remain low.

execution_envelope.liquidity_source: price >= $10 and ADV20 >= $50M from PIT OHLCV
execution_envelope.order_semantics: observe-only next-session-open paper entry; no broker order
execution_envelope.portfolio_displacement: none unless a later shared helper and activation gate pass
execution_envelope.kill_switch: trade_enabled remains false; no production adapter changes
execution_envelope.failure_handling: missing raw SEC annual R&D/revenue pair, missing prior annual comparison pair, stale facts, missing CIK mapping, missing OHLCV, missing next open, or missing 10d exit rejects the paper candidate

production_impact.parity_note: This experiment changes no production code. A positive result is only a replay lead until a shared default-off helper computes the same raw SEC tag mapping, filed-date PIT annual R&D intensity acceleration gate, liquid SPY-relative confirmation, cooldown, next-open paper entry, 10-day exit, costs, and concentration controls in both historical replay and daily production.

post_run_reflection.why_result_happened: The raw SEC R&D intensity acceleration source did not clear Gate 4 (failed: window_ev_regression, window_pnl_regression, fewer_than_two_ev_improved_windows, target_concentration_failed, accepted_compression_ev_not_beaten, accepted_compression_pnl_not_beaten, accepted_distribution_ev_not_beaten, accepted_distribution_pnl_not_beaten). It is not retained or promoted.
post_run_reflection.outcome_summary: Aggregate EV delta +0.1027; aggregate PnL delta $+2,070.05; max drawdown drift +0.0028; 46 paper trades.
post_run_reflection.forbidden_near_neighbor_retry: Do not retry by sweeping R&D intensity, R&D growth spread, revenue floor, annual fact freshness, RS/close/volume/vol guards, top-N, hold days, cooldown, or notional on these frozen windows.
post_run_reflection.new_evidence_required: A retry needs materially different PIT innovation evidence, such as same-period R&D efficiency tied to forward revenue revisions or product-launch/contract evidence. Do not sweep R&D intensity, growth, freshness, revenue floor, RS/close/volume/vol guards, top-N, hold, cooldown, or notional on these frozen windows.
